title: Anyone can use or steal `ArbitrumSwaps` native asset balance
summary: ## Severity  **Likelihood:** High, because this can easily be noticed and exploited  **Impact:** Medium, because value can be stolen, but it should be limited to gas refunds  ## Description  An attacker can steal the `ArbitrumSwaps` native asset balance by doing a call to the `arbitrumSwaps` method with steps `WETH_DEPOSIT` and `WETH_WITHDRAW` - this will send over the whole contract balance to a caller-supplied address.
